description: This file declares the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message. It provides methods to access response ID, check if the response is a result or error, retrieve result or error objects, and validate the response. The class is part of a WebSockets JSON-RPC implementation.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message with methods to access its ID, check its type (result or error), retrieve associated data, and validate the response.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response is a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response.
